Re-Ran on staging

Failed at step 2: 1,149 bills show a Past Due one day less than before the feature was deployed on staging.

Tested on Staging, build v26.45.4-d07623f, on 12 November 2026.

  • This result replaces my "Blocked" result of 14:10 UTC today. That comparison checked rows, columns and amounts only and missed the Past Due column. Measured again on the same saved data: the earlier "Failed" result (13:24 UTC, on the build before, v26.45.4-b8c04e2) still holds on the current build.
  • Step 2: A/P Detail, untouched, as of 11/12/2026, compared with the A/P Detail data saved before the feature (12 Nov 2026 06:46 UTC): 13,047 bills are unchanged; 1,149 bills that are past due show a Past Due one day less than before, in the same column. Example: ZZSOFTHIP Traders' bill ZZSH-O_TYPO, Due Date "Nov 1, 2026", Past Due 10 (it was 11; Nov 1 to Nov 12 is 11 days).
  • Step 2: of the bills not yet due, 357 read one day further below zero and 107 read two days further below zero (for example ZZTOGVEN Supply's ZZINV1725, Due Date "Nov 13, 2026": Past Due -2, it was 0). Each of these bills is due late in the Greenwich evening, which is already the next day in Pakistan time.
  • Step 3 (A/P Unpaid Invoices) was not re-measured document by document on this build; the earlier result shows the same bill with Past Due 10 there.
  • Still open from my 14:10 result: three 4Refuel bills from before the feature ($100.00 each: E2E-Pitcq2q, E2E-P8197vr, E2E-INV-1794217548388, all at Staging Lethbridge - 4310) are no longer listed, and it is not known why.
  • Expected (the case, Step 2): "The same documents and the same amounts, shown the same way … Only the order may differ, and these three changes PRD section 2 lists for this release" - none of the three covers a past-due bill's Past Due changing.
  • No ticket yet: the report is with the QA lead to decide (held). Owning stories SV-11531 and SV-11441.

What needs to be done: nothing for the tester now. When the ticket is decided and fixed, re-run this test on staging against the same saved data (as of 11/12/2026).
